-- in --
package main

templ test() {
	<p>
		In a flowing <strong>paragraph</strong>, you can use inline elements. These <strong>inline elements</strong> can be <strong>styled</strong> and text after an inline element continues the line.
	</p>
	<div>
		@Header()
		@Content()

		@Footer()
	</div>
	<p>one<b>two</b><i>three</i> <!-- note --> four</p>
}
-- out --
package main

templ test() {
	<p>
		In a flowing <strong>paragraph</strong>, you can use inline elements.
		These <strong>inline elements</strong> can be <strong>styled</strong> and text after an
		inline element continues the line.
	</p>
	<div>
		@Header()
		@Content()

		@Footer()
	</div>
	<p>one<b>two</b><i>three</i> <!-- note --> four</p>
}
